claims.statement: For MSR9 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, arity-first m=ceil(n^(1/4)) table/rank/hash/window program otherwise) recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its T=O(n^128 2^((3/4)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+(1/4)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-1/2)+8n^(1/4)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law below. All constants are absolute. Every predicate is an expanded circuit; source/work guards, failed attempts, preparation, storage, full addressing and generation are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.

For MSR9 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, arity-first m=ceil(n^(1/4)) table/rank/hash/window program otherwise) recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its S_C=O(n^(7/4)2^(n^(1/4)sqrt(log2 n)+(1/2)n^(1/4)(log2 n)^(-1/2))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law below. All constants are absolute. Every predicate is an expanded circuit; source/work guards, failed attempts, preparation, storage, full addressing and generation are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/4.

On EVERY branch its S_Q=O(n), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law below. All constants are absolute. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 0.

For MSR9 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, arity-first m=ceil(n^(1/4)) table/rank/hash/window program otherwise) recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its Q=O(n^2 2^((1/4)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+3n^(1/4)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law below. All constants are absolute. Every predicate is an expanded circuit; source/work guards, failed attempts, preparation, storage, full addressing and generation are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.

For the SAME MSR9 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
